Commentary.Commentary: Now the target is a big one! India will have to bat out of their skin if they are to chase this down. A lot will depend on Kaur, Verma and Smriti Mandhana. England on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the chase in a bit.

The Indian bowling was good in bits and pieces! They did manage to take wickets at regular intervals but bowled too many boundary balls. They were in the game till the 14th over but once Sciver and Jones decided to put the foot down, they had no answers to the hitting. Overall, it is not what Kaur would have wanted after electing to bowl.

End of a strong batting display from England women! It was lead by their top order! The openers laid the foundation and then it was the Sciver show. She seemed like she was batting on a different wicket and was hitting boundaries at will. Amy Jones also played as the perfect foil for her. The partnership between the two helped them get to a score which is well above par. Yes, the finish was not that strong but one believes they have got enough.

OUT! Run Out! The dive does not save Sophie! A yorker on middle, this is jammed out back towards the bowler who tries to run the non-stirker out as she was backing up a long way. She misses the throw at her end and it goes towards long on. Yadav there picks it up and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off as the batters go for second. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Ecclestone is short. ENGLAND END WITH 177!
Run out appeal and it is taken upstairs!
SIX! Huge hit by Sophie Ecclestone . Short ball. Powerfully pulled over the square leg fence for a maximum. Much needed boundary after all those wickets.
Gives herself room and muscles it to long on for one.
Driven to long off for a single.
Slower and flatter. Sophie Ecclestone inside edges it onto her pads.
Full and straight. Heaved to deep mid wicket for one.

An appeal for a stumping has been taken upstairs! OUT! Dunkley's foot is in the air! Pandey has another one but another wicket which has to be credited to the fielder, the keeper this time. This is short and outside off, Dunkley misses the cut. She loses her balance and her back foot seems to be outside the crease. The bails are whipped off. It is taken upstairs and replays show that her foot was not inside the crease. India managing to finsih well here.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Shikha Pandey

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! THAT IS A LEGAL CATCH! What a take! Deol, take a bow! Really majestic! This is full and outside off, it is lofted over towards the long off region. It seems to be going all the way! Deol there, times her leap, then takes it but then realizes she is going over the ropes, throws it up in the air, steps out and then dives in to take it. They take it upstairs to check but replays show that it is a clean catch. Deol is pumped up but Amy Jones walks back after a brilliant innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Harleen Deol b Shikha Pandey

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length. Played on the backfoot towards deep mid wicket for a single.
The free hit does
NO BALL! Shikha Pandey loses her grip and balls it way wide. The ball lands outside the pitch and hence a No Ball is called. Free Hit time!

OUT! Caught at Long On! Fabulous diving catch by Harmanpreet Kaur . India have finally got the big wicket of Natalie Sciver which might save them some runs. It was there to be hit, but Sciver did not get a hold of it and gets out. A gem of a innings comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Shikha Pandey

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor start from Shikha Pandey . Fulltoss outside off. Natalie Sciver is set and easily hits it towards forward leg and splits the field.
Slower and given some air. Amy Jones just nudges the ball from off stump towards cover.
Upish but safe. Natalie Sciver lofts the full ball through mid wicket for one.
Pulled the length back a bit. Hit towards long on for a single.
SIX! Amy Jones looking to join the party. Hits the half volley over long on for a biggie. Difficult time for the bowlers.
FIFTY for Natalie Sciver. She's batted beautifully. Uses her feet and just pushes the full ball to long on for one.
Slower ball, soins away from off stump. Hit across to mid wicket for one.
Fuller ball, on the stump. Hit away towards mid wicket. A brilliant stop from the fielder keeps it to a single.
Back of a length, into the pads. Amy Jones misses the sweep and the appeals are subdued.
SIX! Just gets enough on it. Amy Jones lofts it to long on. Valiant effort from the fielder but the ball goes over for a maximum.
Caught in two minds. Full delivery, on leg. Amy Jones can;t decide what shot to play and misses the ball.
FOUR! Brilliant batting by Amy Jones . Drives it on the up towards the cover boundary.
Stayed low. Amy Jones  still manages to work it towards deep mid wicket for two. Good fielding in the deep to stop the boundary.
FOUR! Hammered down the ground again by Natalie Sciver. Expensive over.
FOUR! Back-to-back. That's absolute class from Natalie Sciver. Drives the overpitched ball beautifully through extra cover for another boundary.
FOUR! Cracked! Full ball, hit very hard by Natalie Sciver back past the bowler. Almost took out Arundhati Reddy. Raining boundaries now.
Cheeky shot by Natalie Sciver . Plays the ramp off the stumps over the keeper's head. They come back for two.
Back of a length, on off. Hit down towards cover for another single.
Full ball, driven through cover for a single.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over and Jones is playing a gem here! This is short and outside off, it is slapped through covers for a boundary.
Sciver takes one now as this is worked through square leg.
Another single as this is chipped towards long on.

Two more! On middle and turning away from over the wicket. Jones looks to play the slog sweep, it goes off the top edge, lands safe in the mid-wicket region. The fielder in the deep misfields and two is taken.

FOUR! Outstanding stuff! Playing with the field here! Shorter and on middle, Amy Jones moves across and then pulls it over square leg for another boundary. 8 from the first two balls. Pressure on the bowler now.
FOUR! Really nicely played! The innovation comes out! The reverse sweep, it lands outside off and she hits it with the turn for a boundary through backward point. Good start to the over!
Radha Yadav is back!
A single to end! Just the 5 from the over. On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Dances down the wicket and makes it into a full toss, just the single through as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
It lands in no man's land! On middle, Jones looks to play the slog sweep, this one bonces a touch extra and hence, it goes off the top edge, lands safe in the mid-wicket region for one.
Sciver comes down the track and then works it through mid-wicket for another single.
On middle, this is dragged towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Really slow and outside off, Jones waits and then looks to cut but it goes off the underedge on the off side.
Just over! Jones comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of the ball. She still manages to loft it over the bowler and down to long on for one. A really good over for the hosts.
Now takes one as she eases it down to long on. Good clever batting.
FOUR! Powered! Sciver will not let the momentum slip away! Second boundary in the over. She comes down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball. It is hit hard through mid on for another boundary.
Comes down the track again and gets too close to the pitch of the ball, she hits it hard but back to the bowler.

FOUR! Lovely placement! It seems like Sciver is batting on a different wicket. She skips down the track again but does not get to the pitch of it. She goes with the turn, keeps it down and hits it through mid-wicket for another boundary. A welcome one for England.
On the bounce! Just for a moment Sciver would have had her heart in her mouth! Sciver comes down the track and lofts it down towards long off who runs to her right but it lands well short. Two taken.
A dot to end so back-to-back good overs for India! Jones comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of the ball. She plays it back to the bowler.
Once again Sciver is happy to hang back, she pushes it down to long on for one more.
Jones is off the mark as this is whipped through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.

OUT! THat is brilliant from Sharma but really not sure where Knight was going? It was probably a brain-fade for her. She comes down the track and works it with soft hands to the right of the bowler. She starts jogging down the wicket. Sharma moves to her right and then dives. She stops the ball which is a surprise to Knight who is halfway down the wicket. She looks to turn back and get in but Deepti fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. So India continue to chip away at the wickets.
Powerfully hit but only for one! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through mid-wicket for one.
Deepti Sharma is back!
She indeed can! Knight looks to play the reverse sweep but this is very full outside off. It is jammed out to point. A very good start by Rana.
Tosses it up nicely on off, it is pushed back to the bowler. Can the over end well?
Skips down the track now and makes it into a low full toss, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two dots in the first three balls! Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Misses out there! Short and on the pads, this is pulled but to short fine leg.
SIX! What a HIT! Overpitched, outside off stump. Hit inside-out by the classy Natalie Sciver . Clears the cover boundary for a maximum.
Short and wide. Cut away towards deep point for a single.
Full and straight. Played straight to mid wicket.
FOUR! A bit too straight. Easily swept away by Heather Knight towards the fine leg boundary.
Full on leg stump. Good use of the feet and well stopped by the bowler
Full and straight. Wathfully defended by Heather Knight .

OUT! CAUGHT! Lapse in concentration for Tammy Beaumont. Overpitched ball was lofted without any conviction towards long on. Smriti Mandhana takes a simple catch. Both the openers are out.She actually did not get to the pitch of the ball and also targetted the longer part of the ground. Not the right option. The spinners are slowly getting India back into the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Poonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Knight walks out to bat now!
WIDE! Down the leg side, the sweep it missed. Well collected by the keeper.
Full toss, outside off. Hit away to deep forward for a single.
FOUR! Natalie Sciver rocks back. The short delivery is pulled powerfully to the deep mid wicket boundary. Easy pickings.
Comes down the track and then pushes it to long off for one.
Loopy delivery. Natalie Sciver just reaches the delivery and drives it towards long on for one.
Straight delivery, lled to mid wicket for one.
Overpitched delivery. Pushed forward to long on for another single. Successful over for India,
Good ball. Full again, driven to cover.
Full and outside off. Sciver gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to long on for one.
FOUR! What a way to start from Natalie Sciver . Short ball, cut away towards the point boundary.

OUT! THERE IS A SPIKE ON ULTRA EDGE AND INDIA HAVE THEIR WICKET! That is the reason why they were so confident! Yadav's good form with the ball continues and a welcome wicket for the visitors as this stand was taking the game away. This is tossed up nicely outside off, Wyatt looks to play the reverse sweep, it goes off something to the keeper who takes it and appeals. The umpire turns it down. India review. Replays show that there is an edge.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Laga hai, laga says the keeper and the review is taken! A huge appeal for a caught behind has been turned down. India are confident.
Gives it some air, outside off. Wyatt misses the big heave completely.
1 run.
Just the single from the Free Hit! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
NO BALL! Free Hit coming up! Wyatt comes down the track and this is a high full toss, it is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one. Harsh call that one.
On the bounce! Tammy skips down the track, she does not get to the pitch of it but still goes ahead with the shot. It goes off the inner half but on the bounce to the long on fielder for one.
Two more! Down the leg side, this is swept fine for a couple.
Wyatt comes down the track and makes it into a full toss, it is dragged towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A little bit of turn! This is tossed up nicely, it lands on off and then spins away. Wyatt looks to push at it but is beaten.
Poonam Yadav is on now!
Overpitched, on the stumps. Smartly driven towards long on for one. That ends the Powerplay. Good start by the England openers.

FOUR RUNS! Danni Wyatt uses her feet and lofts it over cover. Good effort by the fielder chasing the ball but unfortunately her feet touch the boundary rope. The umpire signals for a boundary after watching the replay.
Full ball, Danni Wyatt comes forward and hits it straight to Deepti Sharma . Difficult chance dropped.
FOUR! Full ball, on off stump. Danni Wyatt sweeps it nicely to the square leg boundary. The runs keep flowing.
Overpitched again. Driven towards long on for another single. Smart batting.
Full ball, on the stumps. Danni Wyatt comes forward and plays tt towards long on for a single.
This time tries to scoop it on the off side. Misses the delivery just outside the off stump.
FOUR BYES! Tammy Beaumont tries to scoop the delivery down the leg side. In the end, the ball misses everything and goes to the boundary for four byes.
Full ball, coming into the leg stump. Dabbed to mid on. Good bowling.
Good comeback by Shikha Pandey. On off stump, cut away to third man for one.
FOUR! Beautifully played by Danni Wyatt. Full ball straying down the leg side. Swings it over fine leg for a boundary.
Full and straight. Hit hard straight to mid on
Lofted over the infield on the offside by Danni Wyatt. The ball lands safe and the batsmen come back for three.
Slower ball, outside off. Tammy Beaumont gives herself room and heaves it to the leg side. Single taken.
FOUR! Overpitched on off stump. Tammy Beaumont powers it away to the deep mid-wicket fence. First boundary of the game.
Full and straight. Defended back to the bowler
Slower ball. Short and outside off. Sliced away to point for one.
Short and a bit wide. Cut away by Wyatt, but brilliantly stopped at point.
Brilliant fielding again! This is short and outside off, it is cut hard towards point. The fielder dives to her left and gets a hand to it. Saves two for her side.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Brilliant fielding! Fuller and on off, this is hit hard towards mid off. The fielder there dives to her left and stops it brilliantly. Saves three for her side.
Drop and run! On off, Wyatt pushes it towards cover for one.
One more leg bye! Pandey is once again guilty of bowling a little too straight, Tammy looks to flick, it goes off the pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg. A dot.
That is a beauty to end! This is fuller and around off, shapes away late. Wyatt is beaten as he she looks to drive. A decent over by Reddy.
On off, kept out.
Two more! Outside off, Wyatt guides it through point. A couple taken.
Shortish and outside off, this is guided to point for one.

In the air... but safe! Wyatt steps out and Reddy shortens the length. Wyatt looks to loft it over the off side but it goes off the outter half down towards third man. The fielder there runs in and dives forward but fails to get to it. It goes behind towards the fence but the fielder from point who ran there, dives forward and pushes it back in. Saves a run for her side.
Good length and on off, this holds in the surface a touch. Wyatt checks his shot and plays it to covers.
Arundhati Reddy to bowl from the other end!

Another leg bye to end! So 6 from the first over! Once again Pandey brings the ball back in a long way from outside off, Wyatt misses the flick, it hits the pad and rolls on the off side. Another run.
Tammy is underway now! Angled into her pads, once again prodigious movement, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Wyatt opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

Pandey is getting nice amount of movement there! She gets this one to come back in a long way from outside off. Tammy looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Wyatt is off the mark now! Another inswinger, this is worked with the angle towards mid-wicket for one.

TWO WIDES TO BEGIN WITH! England are underway! A big booming inswinger, it tails back in from middle but goes down the leg side. The keeper dives to her left but only manages a hand to it. A single as it rolls towards fine leg.
Time for the action to begin then! The Indian Women make their way out to the middle. The England openers Wyatt and Beaumont also follow. Shikha Pandey has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
INDIA (PLAYING XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Arundhati Reddy, Shikha Pandey, Radha Yadav, Poonam Yadav.

ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Danielle Wyatt, Tammy Beaumont, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Ellen Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Sarah Glenn, Mady Villiers, Freya Davies.
TOSS - It is time for the flip of the coin and it is the Indian skipper who calls it right! She has ELECTED TO FIELD!

A win in the last ODI keeps India's hopes alive in this multi-format tour! A victory in the first T20I will not only see them take a lead in the series but also level points with the host as it is 6-4 in the favor of England at the moment. The Indians will be high on confidence heading into this encounter but they will have to be at their best against England who will be eager to get back to winning ways. This proves to be an exciting contest. Welcome to the coverage. Stay tuned for the toss and teams in a bit.
